groups.alias.title: Alias provenance (read-only response view; ledger entities unchanged)
groups.alias.fields.missing: The response sent no alias_fields: this page does not declare which fields are aliases.
groups.alias.note.missing: The response carried no note: the provenance was not stated with the data, and the page does not write one in.
groups.alias.basis.closed_at: the group ledger's closed_at (the group is closed)
groups.alias.basis.last_event: the last event in the group (largest parsable timestamp)
groups.alias.basis.created_at_fallback: no parsable event in the group -> created_at fallback (never the server clock)
groups.alias.updated.absent: The response sent no updated_at: the page does not fill it in with the browser clock.
groups.progress.note: Denominator = the record count inside this group view (progress.total from the response), never a member count and never an estimate.
groups.progress.members_not_denominator: {members} members: they state who participates; they are not the progress denominator.
groups.resources.elapsed_note: Elapsed time comes from the server's deterministic aggregate window (window.total_ms), not from the browser clock.
groups.resources.window.absent: No window: the group has no parsable timestamps.
groups.agents.color_shared: {count} agents share a colour slot: the backend palette holds only {size} colours while the concurrency limit is 10 agents, so the colour chip is not the identity - the agent name and abbreviation are.
groups.agents.abbr_shared: {count} agents share an abbreviation: the full name disambiguates them; the abbreviation rule is not rewritten and no index suffix is added.
groups.agents.max_note: Showing {shown} agents (concurrency limit {max}): this page never truncates and never silently hides an agent.
groups.timeline.sort.aria: Switch the merged timeline's time order
groups.timeline.bad_time: Missing or unparsable timestamp: kept at the end exactly as the server ordered it, no guessed time.
groups.ungrouped.title: Ungrouped records
groups.ungrouped.note: These records carry no group_id: they get their own column and are never guessed into a group.
groups.ungrouped.more: {count} more are not listed one by one (the count includes them).
groups.create.unavailable: The baseline does not mount POST /api/groups (zero new routes): the form validates locally and shows the server's real code, never a fake success.
